links.outcome: Radiologist performance with versus without AI assistance across 15 chest X-ray tasks; effect of AI errors
links.effect: AI assistance effects were heterogeneous across 140 radiologists; inaccurate AI predictions adversely affected radiologist performance on the aggregate of all pathologies and on half of the individual pathologies.
links.quote: Instead, we found that the occurrence of AI errors strongly influences treatment outcomes, with inaccurate AI predictions adversely affecting radiologist performance on the aggregate of all pathologies and on half of the individual pathologies investigated.

links.outcome: Effect of incorrect AI predictions on radiologist performance (automation bias/overreliance)
links.effect: Inaccurate AI predictions adversely affected radiologist performance on the aggregate of all pathologies and on half of the individual pathologies investigated.
links.quote: Instead, we found that the occurrence of AI errors strongly influences treatment outcomes, with inaccurate AI predictions adversely affecting radiologist performance on the aggregate of all pathologies and on half of the individual pathologies investigated.

unlisted_practices: Personalizing AI assistance to individual clinicians rather than relying on experience-based factors

screen.reason: This is an empirical reader study of 140 radiologists evaluating how AI assistance impacts diagnostic performance and error transmission across chest X-ray tasks.

primary.practice: AI assistance vs unassisted reader evaluation
